rules.statement: A partition suit is not a mere proceeding inter partes to be settled by consent, compromise or the opinion of the Court on points submitted in issues. The paramount duty cast upon the District Judge is to ascertain who are the actual owners of the land.
rules.supporting_quote: "A partition suit is not a mere proceeding inter partes to be settled of consent, or by the opinion of the Court upon such points as they choose to submit to it in the shape of issues. It is a matter in which the Court must satisfy itself that the plaintiff has made out his title"
